header: Two designers and one freight dispatch app
lead: In March 2016, Ana Marques and Tomás Ferreira took one job: redraw the Northwind Logistics dispatch screen. The nine-week project cut handling time from 6.5 to 2.4 minutes.
body: Ten years later, the studio has 24 people in three cities, and the method has hardly changed. We sit with the people who will use the product, sketch it roughly, test it on a Thursday and sketch it again. When a project ends, the client keeps the research recordings, the component files and every prototype. Holding them back is a business model we decided against.
